item.title: OnAirMic 1.0.2 (15)
item.description:
Go Live now works like a radio desk's cue: pick a program from the ⌄ menu next to Go Live to cue it, and Go Live airs it from the top whenever you're ready.

  • Go Live is now disabled when nothing is on air, in progress or coming up, instead of offering to replay a program that already aired.
  • Choosing a program in the ⌄ menu cues it: it gets a checkmark and the button reads “Go Live: <name>”. Choose it again, or Clear Cue, to un-cue it.
  • A cued program takes priority over joining a slot in progress or starting the next program early, and airs for its full duration without airing twice.
  • The Broadcast menu has the same Go Live button and a new Cue submenu.

item.title: OnAirMic 1.0.1 (14)
item.description: • The main window background now takes its colour from your wallpaper, the way Finder does (System Settings › Appearance › Allow wallpaper tinting in windows). Other windows never show through it.

item.title: OnAirMic 1.0.0 (13)
item.description: • The main window now uses the standard macOS window background, tinted by your wallpaper (System Settings › Appearance › Allow wallpaper tinting in windows), so other windows no longer show through it.

item.title: OnAirMic 1.0.0 (12)
item.description: • Settings now sits on a glass card like the other pages, so windows behind OnAirMic no longer show through it.

item.title: OnAirMic 1.0.0 (11)
item.description: • Fixed a stray second outline at the corners of the main window.

item.title: OnAirMic 1.0.0 (10)
item.description:
OnAirMic now keeps itself up to date.

  • Automatic updates: OnAirMic checks for a new version once a day and can download and install it for you.
  • Check for Updates… in the OnAirMic menu, in Settings › Updates, and by right-clicking the menu bar item.
  • Settings › Updates lets you turn automatic checks and automatic installs on or off.
